mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_subject_map ( parent_subject_type, parent_subject_id, child_subject_type, child_subject_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{parentSubjectType}, #{parentSubjectId}, #{childSubjectType}, #{childSubjectId}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (child_subject_type, child_subject_id) DO UPDATE SET parent_subject_type = EXCLUDED.parent_subject_type, parent_subject_id = EXCLUDED.parent_subject_id
